assetOnboardingSourceFile.description: Latest uploaded asset hierarchy file or spreadsheet containing the entity.

configurationLastUpdated.description: Indicates when the configuration of this asset was last updated.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description:
The name of the failure mode.
It should uniquely identify the failure mode.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

description.description: Text that describes the failure mode.

singleUse.description:
Indicates if the failure mode is single-use across cases and alerts.
- `true`: single-use.
- `false`: can be reused.

autoLinkAlert.description:
Indicates whether or not the {@link FailureMode} should be automatically linked to alerts
when creating alerts from model predictions.

userCreated.description:
Indicates whether or not the {@link FailureMode} was created by a user in the UI.
- `true`: user-created.
- `false`: system-generated.

failureModeLibrary.description: The library to which this failure mode record belongs.

failureModeLineItems.description: List of failure mode line items detailing this failure mode.

expectedSensors.description:
Expected sensors to diagnose this failure mode (rule-based or ML-based).
Calculated from the failureModeLineItems.

recommendations.description: All recommendations linked to this failure mode.

countRecommendations.description:
Count of unique recommendations for this failure mode.
Calculated from the recommendations list.

countLineItems.description:
Count of line items associated with this failure mode.
Calculated from the failureModeLineItems list.

title:
The `FailureMode` entity represents a mechanism through which an asset can fail.
It contains various attributes and methods to track and manage failure modes in the system.
name: FailureMode
